facts.fact: Digital Mag reports the state SNDI data centre offers shared services to private companies, and the VITIB public data centre offers colocation space to public entities and approved companies.
facts.system: SNDI and VITIB public data centres

facts.fact: Digital Mag describes the SNDI (Societe nationale de developpement informatique) and VITIB data centres as public data centres managed by ANSUT.
facts.system: SNDI and VITIB public data centres

facts.fact: Digital Mag reports SNDI's data centre is the central hosting point for the public administration, and the public data centres host sensitive data and e-government services.
facts.system: SNDI and VITIB public data centres
